title: Separate User Settings from Owner System Administration
summary: Establish /ayarlar as universal user settings (Profile, Security, Notification preferences, Telegram, Email, Quiet Hours, Appearance) and /admin as Owner Control Center (Dashboard, Users, Catalog, Integrations, Operations, System).
details: Previously, /ayarlar was restricted strictly to OWNER users and contained all system controls, while regular logged-in users had no settings page. Phase 1.5 mandates clear separation: /ayarlar for all users' personal preferences and /admin for owner control.
